# Sani Building Corp

> Sani Building Corp is a Brooklyn-based renovation and repair contractor serving all five NYC boroughs and Long Island since 2015. We handle residential and commercial work — bathroom renovation, tile installation and repair, grout restoration, kitchen cabinet installation, painting, flooring, carpentry, stairs, decks, water damage restoration and same-day handyman service — for homeowners, co-op and condo boards, property managers, restaurants, retail stores and offices. Fully insured. Rated 4.9 stars across 68 Google reviews.

We specialize in work that is quick to schedule and priced from a measured scope: regrouting and tile repair, no-demolition bathroom refreshes with waterproof wall panels, backsplashes, shower waterproofing, and single-room tile installation. Commercial work is scheduled overnight and at weekends so a restaurant or store never loses a day of trading.

## Why customers choose Sani Building Corp
- In business since 2015, based in Brooklyn, working in all five boroughs and Long Island.
- Fully insured. A certificate of insurance (COI) is issued to your building, co-op, condo board or landlord before work starts.
- A written scope and a fixed written price before any work begins — no hourly billing, no surprise add-ons.
- Free estimates from photos sent online, or an on-site visit for larger jobs.
- Floors and common areas are protected, and debris is carried out and hauled away.
- A final walkthrough with the customer at the end of every job. If something is not right, we come back and make it right.
- Restaurants, stores and offices: work can be scheduled overnight and at weekends.
- General contractors and developers: multifamily finish carpentry and cabinet installation. We read the bid package and work from the shop drawings and elevations.
- We do not install or connect gas lines or gas appliances.

## Tile, Grout and Shower
- [Tile Installation](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/bathroom-floor-tile-installation): Bathroom floor, wall and shower tile — porcelain, ceramic, marble, mosaic and large format. Waterproofed and set level.
- [Grout Repair, Regrouting & Tile Repair](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/tile-grouting-restoration): Regrouting showers, repairing cracked or missing grout, replacing broken tiles, grout cleaning, color sealing and epoxy grout.
- [Commercial Tile Installation](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/commercial-tile-installation): Restaurants, retail, medical offices, lobbies and building portfolios. Night and weekend installs.
- [Tile Installation Cost in NYC](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/tile-installation-cost-nyc): Published per-square-foot pricing — what bathroom, commercial and regrouting work actually costs in New York City and what changes the number.
- [Shower & Bathroom Wall Panels](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/bathroom-wall-panels): Waterproof acrylic and PVC shower wall panels in marble and stone looks, installed over existing tile — a grout-free shower surround. No demolition, no dumpster, most bathrooms finished in 1–2 days.
- [Shower Waterproofing & Shower Pan Replacement](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/shower-waterproofing): Leaking shower repair, shower pan replacement, waterproofing membranes behind the tile, and tub-to-shower conversions. 3-year workmanship warranty.

## Carpentry, Stairs and Exterior
- [Carpentry & Millwork](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/carpentry): Custom carpentry, trim, crown molding, closets and built-ins.
- [Finish Carpentry & Millwork Installation](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/finish-carpentry-millwork): Trim, baseboards, door casings, crown molding, wainscoting, built-ins, casework and cabinets; multifamily finish carpentry and cabinet installation for general contractors and developers.
- [Stair Restoration](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/stair-restoration): Brownstone and townhouse staircase restoration, treads, risers and railings.
- [Stair Renovation](https://www.sanibuildingcorp.com/stair-renovation)
